snippet.title: The First Skill-Based Game That Pays Real Money
snippet.description:
They said there was gold in Alaska.
They didn’t tell you it could be yours.
In Fatal Frontier 1869, skilled pioneers can uncover gold worth real money.
Miss your moment - and it’s gone.
👉 Get your New Pioneers Starter Pack, and get diggin' : https://www.fatalfrontier.com/newpioneers
